title: Wanting to play with Duke Ellington
summary: Juan Tizol took him to see Duke, who offered nothing; he had an offer just before Duke's final Tokyo trip but declined.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: Uh-huh. Did you ever want to play with Duke Ellington's band?
I had an offer to play with Duke, just before he died.
Before he went to Tokyo, yes.
But back in the, because Duke's band --

Oh, yes. I wanted so bad to play with Duke's band. I wanted very much to play with Duke. I thought I had an opportunity, at one time, Juan Tizol came over to the Cotton Club and took me to see Duke, says, I think Duke can use you. So he took me over there to the theater, where Duke was playing. And I went -- he took me in the dressing room and set me down there. Duke and I had a talk, he was making up and going on the stage, I sat there for an hour boy he didn't say anything to me about working with his band. I sat there for one hour and I stayed the whole, till they got through. He didn't say one thing about offering me a job. So, I've always wanted to work with Duke, that's my type of band.
He did -- I did get an offer from him just before he went to Tokyo, the last time, but I didn't accept it because I -- I was doing a little better than what he offered at that time.
And I didn't want jump on the band -- I didn't know what I'd have to do there. I didn't want to jump in a band playing lead. I don't do -- I can't do that anymore. That's out.
